scripts.setup: yarn install && yarn setup:client && yarn setup:server
scripts.dev: yarn concurrently "cd server && yarn develop" "npx wait-on http://192.168.22.18:1337 && cd client && yarn dev"
scripts.build:client:with-server: yarn concurrently --kill-others --success first "cd server && yarn develop" "npx wait-on http://localhost:1337 && cd client && yarn build"
scripts.start: yarn concurrently "yarn start:server" "npx wait-on http://192.168.22.18:1337 && yarn start:client"
scripts.start:prod: yarn concurrently "yarn start:server" "npx wait-on http://192.168.22.18:1337 && yarn start:client"
scripts.repo:upstream: git fetch upstream && git merge upstream/main
